confirmed_decisions.note: Seeding makes the corpus non-empty, and at that moment every scout run switches from discovery to reconcile for consumers too, with no opt-out. The flags make it deliberate. Also closes one of the six carried spec gaps from living-system-model-ef.

implement_blocker.finding: The 17 verified declarations resolve to only 14 DISTINCT anchors. Two collision groups: .github/workflows/release.yml is claimed by ci-pre-publish-checks + ci-release + ci-deploy-pages, and .claude/hooks/process_lifecycle_guard.mjs is claimed by phase-trigger + path-trigger.
implement_blocker.why_it_breaks: detectConflicts compares each op against the PRE-EXISTING corpus, never against sibling ops in the same contribution. Proven by probe: three same-anchor ops write cleanly on first apply, then all three raise duplicate-anchor on the second, and rejection is atomic — so the whole 17-element re-apply writes nothing. The seed would look successful and permanently break idempotence.
implement_blocker.interpretation: This is the conflict check working correctly. duplicate-anchor exists to catch two contributors describing the same thing under different names, which is exactly what these are. Spec decision D2 said to distinguish such units by `title`, but title is not what detectConflicts reads — D2 was written against a mechanism that does not exist.

options.A_recommended: 14 elements, one per distinct anchor, merged elements titled to name what they cover. Requires amending AC-001 (says 17) + the scenario recipe + a third gate-A approval.
options.B_rejected: 17 elements with string-distinct anchors pointing at the same file — games the check and puts a lie in the model.
options.C_rejected: Change conflicts.mjs to permit shared anchors — removes a correct check to fit new data, and edits shipped code from last cycle.
options.D_viable: Defer the seed; land flags + drift repair only. Epic 7 E stays dormant.

implement_blocker.secondary_defect: Independent of the seed: a single contribution can create a duplicate-anchor state that the same contribution would reject on re-apply. detectConflicts arguably should check ops against each other. Shipped in 6fc019d; needs its own decision.
implement_blocker.landed_so_far: flags.mjs GREEN (4/4 tests). Seed and drift repair not started.

open_decisions_for_spec: Element granularity — container-level only, or components too. Note: duplicate-anchor fires on EXACT string equality, so nested anchors like .claude/skills/** and .claude/skills/workspace/** coexist without conflict.
Anchor convention, including how to anchor the release-workflow CI jobs that are not code modules.
Whether WorkspaceView is in scope — readAll returns {elements, views} and the class diagram declares it, but nothing writes views and no AC covers them.
Which decisions/constraints/landmarks each element links to via governed_by/rests_on (D4, by key never by copy).
